descriptionChirho: The Hebrew proper name Tobiah (טוֹבִיָּה) or its longer form Tobijah (טוֹבִיָּהוּ), meaning 'Yah(u) is my good.' This name refers to several individuals in the Old Testament: (1) a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach in the cities of Judah (2 Chr 17:8); (2) the Ammonite servant who opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls (Neh 2, 4, 6, 7, 13); (3) one of the returned exiles from whom gold and silver were taken to make a crown (Zech 6:10, 14). All occurrences share the same etymological and onomastic identity regardless of prepositional prefixes (ל, ו) or spelling variation between the shorter and longer forms.
